title: Caller moves an appointment; agent is slow and talks over them once
source: synthetic: written for this repo to show the timing metrics, not a real call
goal: Did the agent move the caller's appointment to the day and time they asked for?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sure. What day works best for you?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: On Friday I have 8:30 AM or 1 PM. Which would you prefer?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great. Can I get your full name, please?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Sorry. It's Sam Iverson. One PM is fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: To confirm: moving your appointment to Friday at 1 PM for Sam Iverson. Is that right?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You're all set, Sam. We'll see you Friday at 1 PM. Is there anything else?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling. Have a great day!
